facts.ask: Which Soul Society district did you grow up in?
Who is the strong rival from Karakura you fought twice?
Which Espada did you fight in Hueco Mundo?

traps.truth: Yachiru Kusajishi was his lieutenant and vanished in the war; Ikkaku is his 3rd seat.

traps.ask: Is Kenpachi the name your parents gave you?
traps.truth: Kenpachi is a title, not his birth name; he has no known birth name.

traps.ask: You're captain of the 6th Division, right?
traps.truth: He is captain of the 11th Division; the 6th is Byakuya's.

traps.ask: I hear Aizen is your zanpakuto's master. Is that true?
traps.truth: Nozarashi is his own zanpakuto; Aizen has Kyoka Suigetsu.
Ichigo struck down Yhwach; Kenpachi fought other Quincy.
